I. O. REC
No. 138
Date

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
9/3
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

3rd March 1916.

Sir,
A band of Manchus numbering 132 or 133 arrived
in Shanghai from Mukden on February 18th. They were
in charge of two officers, one of whom is a native
of Chekiang. He left Shanghai on February 24th for
Soochow and Nanking with 15 men; the other officer
took charge of the remainder of the band and left
for Hankow and the ports beyond. The object of
these two bands is to assassinate persons who are
prominent or active at the present moment in opposing
Yuan Shih Kai. They stayed in a house in the French
Concession whilst here.
The headquarters of the Koh Ming Tong is about
to be removed from Shanghai to Soochow. The war fund
of the party is now reported to have reached a million
dollars. The money is not in a bank but stored in
boxes in a house in the French Concession.

Your obedient servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Referred to Command, S.V.C., for information.

for C.S.P.

刑事侦缉处
情报官收件
第 138 号
日期

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
9/3
警务处，
（侦探分部）

1916 年 3 月 3 日。

先生：
一批满人于 2 月 18 日从奉天抵达上海，人数为 132 或 133 人。他们由两名军官率领，其中一人是浙江籍。他于 2 月 24 日带领 15 人离开上海前往苏州和南京；另一名军官则率领其余人员离开，前往汉口及更远的港口。这两批人的目的是刺杀当前在反对袁世凯方面地位显赫或活动积极的人士。他们在沪期间居住在法租界的一处房屋内。
光复会总部即将从上海迁往苏州。据悉，该党的战争基金现已达到一百万元。这笔钱未存入银行，而是装在箱子里，存放在法租界的一处房屋内。

您忠实的仆人，

首席侦探督察。

警务处总监。

转交万国商团司令部，供知悉。

代警务处总监
